This page traces every data element in the HIQA Draft National Standard for Electronic Prescriptions and
Electronic Dispensations (September 2026) to where it is represented in IE MPD. It is generated from the
committed mapping sources, so the IG and this table cannot drift apart.

<div class="note-to-balloters" markdown="1">

**Status: based on a consultation draft.** The HIQA standard is a draft for public consultation
(closing 21 October 2026) and will change. This IG is a proof of concept with no affiliation with HIQA, the HSE, HL7 Ireland,
HL7 Europe or the Department of Health.

</div>

**Status values:** *Aligned*: represented, with cardinality and MustSupport consistent with HIQA conformance. *Partial*: represented, but cardinality, MustSupport, binding or semantics differ (see notes). *Gap*: not represented. *Prohibited (violated / enforced)*: personal data that is **not** in the dataset for this use case and so must not be sent; "violated" means the IG still allows or encourages it. *N/A*: not applicable to a FHIR exchange.

**Conformance convention:** HIQA Mandatory → `min ≥ 1` + MustSupport; Required → MustSupport; Optional → allowed, no MustSupport.

Logical model: [HIQA ePrescription/eDispensation](StructureDefinition-HIQAEPrescriptionLM.html). Machine-readable matrix: `docs/hiqa-2026/traceability-matrix.csv` in the source repository.
